question:
If one flies from north to south over India, which would be the correct order of the rivers?

1) Kaveri

2) Mahanadi

3) Krishna

4) Ganga

5) Godavari
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**4 - 2 - 5 - 3 - 1**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

**Rivers of India:**

 
• Indian rivers are separated into two groups based on their sources: Himalayan Rivers and Peninsular Rivers.
 
• The majority of the rivers in India **flow eastward **into the **Bay of Bengal.**
 
• The western portion of India supplies the** Arabian Sea** with the remaining **10%** of its rivers.
 
• The four principal **Himalayan rivers **are the** Indus, Ganga, Yamuna, **and **Brahmaputra.**
